translations.web: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
translations.bsb: How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?
translations.kjv: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted
